periods.description: Copper mines exploited for 333 years until 1977; documented discovery and extraction history begins in 1644.
First coal extracted in 1851; shafts closed on 23 December 1986.
Industrial copper extraction and shipment; mines temporarily closed in 1932.
Mines reopened in 1935 and closed in October 1938.
Aikawa gold and silver operation founded in 1601; source documents 388 years of production and suspension in March 1989.
Mitsubishi full-scale undersea coal exploitation began in 1890; island colliery closed in January 1974.
Provincial mining report records 53 years of continuous operation before production stopped on 12 March 1958.
Operator records operation since 1915 and copper production in 2025.
Pit 1 operational mining began in 1981 and ended in December 1994.
Pit 3 extraction ran from July 1997 to November 2012.
Conservative production phase from the profitable Pewabic-lode era; copper production stopped in 1931.
Reopened in 1937; underground copper mining stopped in 1945.
Nineteen radiocarbon dates suggest mining for approximately eight centuries, circa 1700–900 BCE.
Roman hydraulic gold extraction during the first two centuries CE; UNESCO places the beginning in the first century and abandonment in the early third.
Copper production documented since at least the ninth century, continuing into the late twentieth century.
Operator history records commercial uranium mining from 1976 and 48 years of continuous production through the 2024 reporting year.
Technical Report Summary, sections 5.1.3 and 13: lithium mining began in 1983 and remained in operation in 2024, with production reported for that year.
LKAB Summary Technical Report for 2023, section 5.1: continuous iron-ore production since 1898, with annual mined production through 2023.
SGU 2001 Table 5 records separate apatite production during 1985–1988, based on Swedish mining production statistics.
OCP chronology documents phosphate extraction from 1921 and the underground phase ending in late 1993, before replacement by Sidi Chennane open-pit operations in 1994.
Dated September 2024 operator/IFC release attests the active Khouribga production operations; this observation does not infer intervening years.
SGU 2001 Table 5 lists iron-ore production in the closed Rektorn mine during 1925–1961, from Swedish Mining Inspectorate final mine records.
The same SGU production table separately records apatite extraction during 1942–1946; the report describes wartime apatite production for fertilizer.
